name: Macroeconomic stability and predictability
summary: Keeping growth high and prices stable, with a larger economy, higher incomes and deeper financial inclusion.

name: Fiscal sustainability
summary: Raising more domestic revenue and keeping debt affordable, so the plan can actually be paid for.

name: External-sector resilience
summary: Stronger, more diversified exports and healthy reserves to weather external shocks.

name: Agriculture
summary: The backbone of the economy and jobs, being modernised for higher value and fewer losses.

name: Industry and manufacturing
summary: Moving from raw materials to finished goods, the core of industrialisation.

name: Construction
summary: Building the housing and infrastructure a growing, urbanising country needs.

name: Mining and quarrying
summary: Turning minerals into value at home, not just raw exports.

name: Oil and gas
summary: Monetising natural gas for energy security and industry.

name: Tourism
summary: A top export earner, aiming to become a leading African destination.

name: Financial sector
summary: The economy's lifeblood, channelling savings into productive investment, with deeper inclusion and stronger institutions.

name: Sports and creative industries
summary: One of the fastest-growing sectors, turning music, film, fashion and sport into jobs and exports.

name: Housing and real estate
summary: Homes, land and modern settlements for a fast-urbanising nation, backed by digital land records.

name: Trade and commerce
summary: Deeper participation in African and global trade, and e-commerce for small businesses.

name: A robust business sector
summary: A stronger private sector driving investment, credit and jobs.

name: Regional and global cooperation
summary: Attracting foreign investment and deepening regional and global economic ties.

name: Formalising the economy
summary: Bringing the vast informal economy into the formal system to widen the tax base and extend protection.

name: A well-educated, skilled society
summary: Building the skilled, learning society a modern economy needs.

name: A capable, motivated workforce
summary: Shifting the workforce from low skills toward medium and high skills for a modern economy.

name: The demographic dividend
summary: Turning a young, growing population into a productivity dividend by easing the dependency burden.

name: Labour market and employment
summary: More and better jobs, especially for youth and people with disabilities.

name: Social protection and inclusion
summary: Widening the safety net so the poor, elderly, disabled and children are covered.

name: Health care for all
summary: Universal health coverage and a stronger, better-funded system.

name: Food security and nutrition
summary: Better nutrition for mothers and children, cutting stunting, anaemia and malnutrition.

name: Water and sanitation
summary: Clean water and sanitation for every household.

name: A cohesive society
summary: Safer communities, fewer road deaths, and action against crime and violence.

name: Inclusive rural development
summary: Lifting rural areas through a measured transformation of incomes and services.

name: Co-operatives transformation
summary: Professionalising cooperatives so they reach millions more members and add value.

name: A growing middle class
summary: Growing the middle-income class from a small minority toward the African average.

name: Environmental integrity
summary: Protecting forests, wetlands and biodiversity while cutting deforestation and expanding conservation.

name: Sustainable urbanisation
summary: Planning fast-growing cities, surveying land and formalising unplanned settlements.

name: Sustainable land management
summary: Securing land tenure and setting land aside for industry.

name: Climate-change resilience
summary: Cutting emissions, scaling renewables and clean cooking, and reducing climate damage.

name: Early-warning systems
summary: Investing in disaster risk reduction and getting timely alerts to more people.

name: Participation in carbon trade
summary: Turning forests and ecosystems into carbon revenue through certified projects.

name: The blue economy
summary: Harnessing the ocean, lakes and coast, from fisheries to marine tourism and protected waters.

name: Energy
summary: Doubling power capacity and reaching three-quarters of households, with cleaner cooking.

name: Integrated logistics
summary: Faster-growing transport and logistics to move goods and connect markets.

name: Science, technology and innovation
summary: Climbing the global innovation rankings and lifting research spending.

name: Research and development
summary: Grounding government decisions in local research evidence.

name: A data-driven ecosystem
summary: Better statistics and open data to plan and govern with evidence.

name: Digital transformation
summary: A bigger digital economy, more smartphones and stronger cybersecurity.

name: ICT infrastructure and services
summary: Broadband, internet access and digital skills for everyone.

name: Communication and courier services
summary: Wider mobile, postal and courier coverage, including 4G and 5G.

summary: A more predictable

summary: Keeping the country stable and clean while climbing rule-of-law and anti-corruption rankings.

name: Strong local governance
summary: More capable and transparent councils delivering services closer to citizens.

name: Digital governance and smart data
summary: Government services online and digital ID for most citizens.

name: Mindset change to embed reforms
summary: Shifting attitudes so reforms stick, tracked by the Social Progress Index.
